mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (payment_no, partner_id, payment_type, amount, payment_date, method, memo, status, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{paymentNo}, #{partnerId}, #{paymentType}, #{amount}, #{paymentDate}, #{method}, #{memo}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, payment_no, partner_id, payment_type, amount, payment_date, method, memo, status, created_by, created_at, canceled_at FROM payment WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, payment_no, partner_id, payment_type, amount, payment_date, method, memo, status, created_by, created_at, canceled_at FROM payment ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
